build_markers_entity: build a Markers entity with configurable player colors and board size for MuJoCo board games
create_marker_sites: create cylindrical marker sites for each player using MJCF root element and materials
mark_player_position: mark a player move by placing a visible marker at a cartesian position on the board
reset_markers_episode: reset all markers to origin and invisible state at the start of a new episode
observe_marker_positions: observe cartesian positions of all marker sites as a numpy array via MJCFFeature
